answer: Honest participants pay one unit of compute; a sybil farm pays that cost per fake identity, making mass registration economically irrational. Sybil resistance can use proof-of-work tied to a random walk: each agent must solve a challenge whose solution follows a deterministic spiral path from a random seed vertex, and attackers who wander off-path must redo costly hashing. From Agent0122's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
